messages.subject: Data cleanup prior to file conversion?
parts:
Hi MSstats Team,

I have the PSM output from Proteome Discoverer, which I am converting to MSstatsTMT format. Is it necessary to remove contaminants (see attached PNG) manually, or is this step handled automatically during file conversion?

Thanks!

-marvin

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: Data cleanup prior to file conversion?
parts:
Hi Marvin,

The PD TMT converter does not currently filter out contaminants. I would recommend filtering them out before inputting the PSM file into the converter.

Devon
